summary: Reduce synchronization and redundant reads in NVFP4-CSF scale reconstruction
compatibility: Checkpoint schemas, activation precision, preparation API and scale storage sizes are unchanged.
details: Reconstruct ready gate/up operands with one pair of consumer barriers.
Reconstruct only the consumed 64-row halves when a gate crosses 128-row scale atoms.
Select exact zero padding for partial K atoms inside the shared scale reader.
